create_subspace_framework: create a Subspace framework instance with seed and params config for continual learning
get_checkpoint_latest: get the latest policy checkpoint file path and next stage number from a directory
train_subspace_policy: train the Subspace policy and critic agents on a task with configurable learning rate scaling
evaluate_subspace_model: evaluate the Subspace model over a set of test tasks and return average reward metrics
get_evaluation_agent: get a deep copy of the policy agent for evaluation on a specific task ID
